facts.fact: The BMJ Open study says the eRegister, piloted in 2018, is configured to compile and send facility-level data automatically into the district health information management system, and that three pilot facilities were using it when interviewed.
facts.system: eRegister to district health information management system data flow

systems.owner: Ministry of Health with implementing partners (ICAP funds it)
systems.tiers: four health centres and two hospitals piloted; 178 government facilities planned

note: The as_of is the start of the interview period, December 2023 to March 2024; the configuration statement itself cites a 2022 source.
